sentences.en: Few things can match the unmitigated fury of child preachers.
sentences.zh: 1. 几乎没有什么能比得上童年的传道者所散发出的那种毫无掩饰的愤怒。

sentences.en: I, the Preacher, was king over Israel in Jerusalem.
sentences.zh: 2. 我这位传道者，在耶路撒冷曾是以色列国王。

sentences.en: I believe that the preacher could not speak "Amen."
sentences.zh: 3. 我认为那位传道者无法说出“阿门”。
